papers.title: Half directional total variation algorithm for pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance imaging
papers.authors: C Fang, R Hu, R Yang, J Xue, P Liu, Y Zhang, W Wang… - Measurement, 2026
papers.abstract: To obtain projection signals with a sufficiently high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for the filtered back projection (FBP) algorithm, electron paramagnetic resonance imaging (EPRI) requires that each projection be collected multiple times and averaged. This process is inherently time-consuming. While reducing acquisition repetitions per projection is a common scanning acceleration strategy, the resulting increase in projection noise hinders the performance of the FBP reconstruction. papers.title: Empirical Gradient-Driven Continuous-Time SGD: Generalization Gap Dynamics and Practical Adaptive Training
papers.authors: K Cui, W Li - Machine Learning, 2026
papers.abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) underpins deep learning, yet traditional continuous-time analyses rely on the population gradient assumption, ignoring mini-batch noise and yielding impractical generalization bounds that contradict observed stable gaps in overparameterized models. We propose an empirical gradient-driven continuous-time SGD framework, which captures mini-batch noise via an Itô diffusion with empirical-gradient drift and diffusion.
